### Gate Rules Applied

- Need was decided before treatment.
- Existing carriers were inspected before any Create or Update decision.
- Performance, risk, quality, and finance reports are generated views, not maintained sources.
- Performance measures are combined from existing acceptance, gate, dashboard, and register records; missing thresholds remain an explicit gap.
- Missing evidence did not justify creating a new artifact.
- No artifact-index entry, external document, or canonical register was changed.
- Human validation is required at Stage 04 before the generated performance assessment is used for a commitment or decision.

|---|---|---|
| Relevance | Pass | Loaded sources support the selected performance process: outcome, scope, schedule, quality, access, operations, resources, finance, governance, risk, and architecture. |

## Stage 02 Conclusion

The evidence package is sufficient to perform PM-07. The main performance question is not whether local code is progressing; it is whether the remaining Gate 1, staging, operations, acceptance, ownership, and decision conditions can support the conditional launch path. Continue to Stage 03. No canonical record or artifact-index change is authorized by this evidence package.
